title: Scheduled recheck, 4 Oct 2026 04:53 (31 queued items)
scope: Scheduled recheck of the 31 queued items (28 plans flagged for supporting mechanics, 3 official mechanics notices) against the live bundles published 2026-10-04T07:39:16+00:00 (collection of 3 Oct 23:22 UTC, in which Pred.gg failed on every rank; four ranks kept Pred.gg 168 game data from 3 Oct 14:06-14:26 CDT, Gold+ and Platinum+ fell back to omeda.city). Not a weekly or full review.
standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md: a plan whose reasoning still holds is checked and retained, with its precondition updated from the live source where that source changed; a mechanics notice resolves only with official text, otherwise it is unresolved and held with its queue evidence.

entries.reason: The 3 Oct 23:22 UTC collection got no Pred.gg response on any rank (watchdog issue #117). Bronze+, Silver+, Diamond+ and Paragon+ kept their Pred.gg game data from earlier on 3 Oct (version 168, collected 14:06-14:26 CDT); Gold+ and Platinum+ did not, and fell back to omeda.city item and kit text. The queue reads the Gold+ bundle, so it flags fields where omeda.city words them differently. For Elafrost, the Pred.gg 168 item on the four ranks that kept it still equals the plan's precondition exactly, and on those ranks the plan is active. Against the omeda.city fallback, the only difference is the match-tracker label "Times Applied" vs "Times Applied to Heroes" in the stats footer; no numeric value, trigger, cooldown or scaling differs. The official 1.17 notes and Hotfix 1.17.1 add no change to Elafrost since the plan's review. The plan's reasoning holds; no part and no precondition changes (rewriting the precondition to the fallback wording would deactivate the plan on the four ranks that still carry the reviewed source).
entries.limitation: Gold+ and Platinum+ keep showing the plan as inactive until a collection gets Pred.gg data again (next attempt 4 Oct 17:23 UTC); the queue item will return on each run until then. Only the flagged supporting mechanic was rechecked; the plan's item order and statistics were not re-reviewed. No in-game test.
mechanics_checked: Item Elafrost (Pred.gg 168 on four ranks against the plan precondition; omeda.city fallback on Gold+/Platinum+)
